title: Concept: Lockfile resolves a package over cleartext HTTP
description: package-lock.json declares a lockfile entry that resolves its tarball over cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Cleartext transport lets a network attacker replace the tarball in flight, and the integrity value only helps if it is checked against the substituted bytes.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through package-lock.json (npm).
risk: Cleartext transport lets a network attacker replace the tarball in flight, and the integrity value only helps if it is checked against the substituted bytes.
